w:r.w:t: Smart Parking Management System is an intelligent parking management platform built for a building / mixed-use complex. The system enables real-time tracking of parking sessions, advance booking management with deposits, automatic fee calculation based on flexible pricing policies, automatic incident detection via gate cameras, and revenue reporting — all through a web interface.
The system consists of two applications:
Web Admin (Next.js 15): For Manager, Staff, and Admin to manage the parking lot
REST API (Spring Boot 3 / Java 21): Backend handling all business logic, integrated with PayOS for online payments
System administration: manage user accounts, permissions, view audit logs, system configuration
Parking operation management: manage floors, slots, vehicle types, pricing policies, booking quotas, view revenue reports, handle incidents
Gate operation: perform check-in/check-out, handle incidents, simulate camera
Parking lot users: view parking lot info, advance booking, pay deposit, view parking history, send feedback

Job runs every 5 mins: session in `Admitted` status over 15 mins without entering a slot → auto create `IncidentReport` type `Loiterer`. Avoid duplicates by checking existing incidents before creating.
Automatically close session of vehicle left slot for too long
Job runs every 5 mins: session `Moved` (left slot) over 30 mins without checking out → auto close session (`status = Completed`), create `IncidentReport` type `Overstay` for manual reconciliation.

Job runs every 15 mins: booking `Pending`/`Confirmed` past `expectedEntryTime` + grace period (configurable) without checking in → cancel (`status = Expired`) and lose deposit (`depositStatus = Forfeited`).

Integrate online deposit payment. System creates PayOS QR link; PayOS calls webhook to confirm when payment is successful. Webhook has checksum validation and idempotency by orderCode.
Use Hibernate `ddl-auto: validate`. All schema changes must run ALTER TABLE script in `sql/` folder before startup.
Stateless authentication. Bearer Token is checked at every endpoint (except `/api/auth/**` and public webhooks).
Automatically generate API documentation at `http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui.html`. Used for testing in development environment.
Never overbooking: calculate headroom and create session/reservation in `SERIALIZABLE` transaction.
Capacity-Crash Cascade automatically cancels bookings when maintenance slot causes capacity deficit.
PayOS webhook and mock callback check for duplicates before creating Payment record.
Force Check-in action is permanently recorded in AuditLog, cannot be deleted.
Capacity queries use GROUP BY instead of N+1 loops. SERIALIZABLE transaction is only used when necessary (check-in, create booking), other endpoints use lower isolation.

Background scheduler (`SessionExpiryScheduler`) runs independently; failure of one job does not affect the main API.
Business configuration (`FeeConfig`) changes immediately via API without restarting the server.
Exit time must be after entry time when creating advance booking
Driver can only cancel the booking when more than 3 hours remain before expectedEntryTime
Driver self-cancels → deposit refunded (Refunded); Scheduler no-show → deposit lost (Forfeited)
Walk-in headroom = C - Inside(t) - Outstanding(t); headroom ≤ 0 → reject walk-in
Booking reserves spot, NOT specific slot. Slot status is only changed by CV camera or Manager
Fee is calculated server-side; FE must not auto calculate or pass amount
Park over 24h → overstay surcharge = overstayRatePerHour × extraHours
Lost card → add lostTicketFee when checking out at the counter
Force Check-in permanently recorded in AuditLog, flag `isForceCheckIn = true` on session
When a slot switches to Maintenance causing a deficit → cancel the newest booking first (prioritize keeping older bookings)
Booking Quota is applied by time slot; if there is no quota for that time slot → no limit
Payment record must not be duplicated (idempotent check before saving)
Password must be BCrypt hashed before saving to database
All APIs (except `/api/auth/**` and `/api/driver/parking-info`, PayOS webhook) require `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
Every response has a unified structure: `{ success, message, data, errorCode }`
Business error returns HTTP 400 with `errorCode` for FE to distinguish the error type
Resource not found error returns HTTP 404
Database schema is not auto created/edited (`ddl-auto: validate`); any schema changes require manual SQL script
